leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a React context to manage global notification state.
Initialize the notification context with a default state and a dispatch function.
Implement a context provider component to wrap the application and supply the notification state.
Apply the useContext hook within components to access the notification context.
Manipulate the notification state by dispatching actions to add or remove notifications.
Render dynamic notification components based on the current context state.
Integrate the notification context into existing components to display user feedback.
